_note: Built-in customer-support preset. Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:support. Plan, account status and entitlements are confirm "auto": a clear change applies at once and is marked in history, and an uncertain one waits for a person. Issues and preferences apply immediately; a new preference that contradicts one on record ("call me" against "no calls") is checked first. Issues, preferences, and entitlements are lists.

slots.name: account_status
slots.description: the customer's account status (active, suspended, churned)

slots.name: open_issue
slots.description: an unresolved issue or support ticket for the customer (a customer may have several)

slots.name: preference
slots.description: a stated customer preference, e.g. preferred contact channel

slots.name: entitlement
slots.description: a feature, add-on, support level, credit or discount the customer has
